annotations.title: Check whether a DESIGN.md copy is still current

description: Every DESIGN.md carries a Fingerprint line. Pass the id and that fingerprint; the server answers whether the copy matches the current token set, and if not, returns the current tokens so the agent can update the file instead of following a stale one. Call this at the start of a session when a DESIGN.md is already in the repo.

fingerprint.description: The value from the DESIGN.md Fingerprint line, e.g. "fnv1a-9c2a41d7".

id.description: Theme or template id from the DESIGN.md Source line.
